primaryChecks.text: He built Elath and restored it to Judah. After that the king slept with his fathers.
primaryChecks.previousContext: All the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the place of his father Amaziah.
primaryChecks.nextContext: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah, Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria for forty-one years.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 本文に地名が明記される。用例の地理的意味はprofile本文で限定した。

primaryChecks.text: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drove the Jews from Elath; and the Syrians came to Elath, and live there to this day.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to wage war. They besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him.
primaryChecks.nextContext: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, saying, “I am your servant and your son. Come up and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria and out of the hand of the king of Israel, who rise up against me.”
